name: Mike P. Nelson
bio: Michael Paul Nelson (born December 18, 1982) is an American filmmaker. He is best known for directing the horror films The Domestics (2018), Wrong Turn (2021) and Silent Night, Deadly Night (2025) and Beware Boiúna (2026).

credits.title: Untitled Saw Film
credits.overview: The eleventh film in the series. Plot details TBA.

credits.title: Beware Boiúna
credits.overview: A medical mission deep in the Amazon becomes a desperate fight for survival when a colossal ancient predator awakens, turning the jungle into a deadly battleground where nature decides who lives and dies.

credits.title: Silent Night, Deadly Night
credits.overview: After witnessing his parents' brutal murder on Christmas Eve, Billy transforms into a Killer Santa, delivering a yearly spree of calculated, chilling violence. This year, his blood-soaked mission collides with love, as a young woman challenges him to confront his darkness.

credits.title: Sweet Revenge
credits.overview: A group of teenagers, arrives in Crystal Lake Camp, but one thing they don't know about this place, is they were being stalked and mysteriously killed by a mysterious serial killer who's out there for revenge.

credits.title: V/H/S/85
credits.overview: Unveiled through a made-for-TV documentary, five chilling tales of found footage horror emerge to take viewers on a gore-filled journey through the grim underbelly of the forgotten 1980s.

credits.title: Edge of Insanity
credits.overview: Feeling guilty about her parents death and determined to live up to their expectations, Rylee will stop at nothing to become an actress, no matter what the cost.

credits.title: Wrong Turn
credits.overview: Jen and a group of friends set out to hike the Appalachian Trail. Despite warnings to stick to the trail, the hikers stray off course—and cross into land inhabited by The Foundation, a hidden community of mountain dwellers who use deadly means to protect their way of life.

credits.title: One Minnesota
credits.overview: Horror drama about a team-up for wealth.

credits.title: The Domestics
credits.overview: A young husband and wife must fight to return home in a post-apocalyptic mid-western landscape ravaged by gangs.

credits.title: The Goodbye
credits.overview: A screenwriter struggling to complete a ninja script must confront the death of the love of his life in order to move on with his own.

credits.title: The Retirement of Joe Corduroy
credits.overview: A quiet dentist finds a new purpose in retirement when his nephew is left comatose by a violent mugging. Joe takes to the streets to show the city's riffraff a new light; the muzzle flash of a Mauser pistol.

credits.title: An American Classic
credits.overview: A jealous boyfriend trys to redeem his obsession with his lost love.

credits.title: Summer School
credits.overview: Having spent the last three days watching crappy B grade horror films, to catch up on his website movie reviews, Charles attempts to attend his first day of Summer School. credits.title: The 26th
credits.overview: 'Twas the night after Christmas... Johnny and I were in the basement. I was carving some wood. Johnny was painting some toy cars. That's when I heard the man come into the house.

credits.title: The G.I.
credits.overview: World War II, Winter, 1944. Michael, a corporal in the 89th Division Rolling W's, gets separated from his squad during a Nazi ambush. He soon realizes that the Nazis and the piercing cold are the least of his worries, for what lurks in the woods is even more horrific.
